_comment: The recommender engines: the models that READ a task and WRITE the three picks (not the models they recommend). The single source of truth for both deployments: the service runs an engine from this file (service/app/engines.py), and the web build copies it beside the catalog (web/scripts/sync-catalog.mjs) to build the /recommend engine menu and its access rules. Hand-edited; the measured figures shown in the menu live in docs/engine-eval.json (generated by scripts/eval_recommend_engines.py). Fields: hint = the force_provider wire id the web sends; catalog_id = the docs/catalog.json model it bills as; model = the provider's own id for it; thinking_budget = the adapter's reasoning dial (0 = the model's floor: reasoning.effort minimal/low on OpenAI, thinking level low on Gemini 3, effort low on Claude, thinking off on Gemini 2.5); max_output_tokens / ladder_max_output_tokens = the single-pick and three-pick output caps (reasoning counts against both); temperature = sent only where the model accepts sampling; menu = who may choose it on /recommend (public = anyone, signed_in = any account, founder = the operator allowlist, null = runnable but not offered).

engines.notes: The default from 2026-09-22 to 2026-10-02 (12-probe differential vs gpt-5-mini: 12/12 parsed, no cost-demotion of the Quality pick). Reasoning at its floor (low; the 5.6 generation has no minimal). Twice GPT-6 Luna's cold cost; still on the menu.

The default since 2026-10-02. 12-probe engine eval (scripts/eval_recommend_engines.py): 12/12 parsed with every field and section, healthy ladders, $0.0015 per recommendation with the prompt cached ($0.0066 cold) — the cheapest engine — and Quality anchored on the flagship (Opus 5.5) on 11/12 probes even before the anchor-rule fix. Needs roadmodel >= 0.2.56 for its reasoning cap.
Gemini's current Flash, thinking level low (roadmodel >= 0.2.56 maps budget 0 to the level). The second link in the fallback chain: a different provider from the default.
Claude's small model: no thinking, takes temperature. The cached system prompt (roadmodel >= 0.2.56) makes a warm call read the prompt at $0.10 per 1M. Last link in the fallback chain.
OpenAI's mid-tier flagship at $2/$10 per 1M, reasoning at its floor.
Effort low with adaptive thinking (Sonnet 5+ rejects temperature). The cached prompt reads at a tenth of the input price.
Thinking cannot be disabled on Opus 5.5; effort low keeps it brief. The most expensive engine on the menu.
Same price as GPT-6.1 Sol, which supersedes it. Runnable for comparison.
One tier up from Luna in the 5.6 generation. Runnable for comparison.
The engine before GPT-5.6 Luna (2026-07-19 to 2026-09-22). Kept for rollback.
The original free engine. Thinking off (#132 latency); the 512-token cap bounds the runaway-rationale tail (#146); temperature 0 for determinism (#176). Kept for rollback.
The pre-registry fallback hint, unchanged (provider defaults). Kept so an older web build that pins it keeps working.
